name: C++ III — Advanced C++, Smart Pointers & Move Semantics
description: Master move semantics, smart pointers (unique_ptr, shared_ptr), lambdas, exception handling, and build a Mini Compiler Core.
whatYouLearn: Eliminate memory leaks using smart pointers (std::unique_ptr)
Master move semantics and rvalue references (&&)
Write inline lambda expressions with captures
Build a Mini Compiler Core Capstone
